purpose: Observe bounded existing response/validation failures under the original accumulated input prefix; no asserted cause and no service behavior change.
input: Reuse original verified ASCEND input manifest and exact PCM files in original order. No reselection, correction, trimming, resampling or text hints.
model: Original Zipformer int8 CPU, two threads, greedy search, auto language, model endpoint detection disabled; four model asset hashes and staged service scripts must be recorded.
transport: Same production AsrClient, response function and validator. Unpaced20ms/320-sample chunks with response backpressure, final5-second request timeout; do not copy or weaken production response logic.
right_context: Unchanged existing recognizer final flush of9600 zero samples/600ms model context; no source silence added.

diagnostics.failure_detail: Existing local static error string or numeric HTTP-status string, bounded to240 Unicode characters; no raw reqwest error, header, bearer token or response body
diagnostics.failure_sequence: Current attempted chunk index, or next sequence for final; null when no sequence-bearing request is attempted
diagnostics.failure_payload_bytes: Current chunk payload length; null for start/final or no request
diagnostics.failure_last_valid_revision: Revision before a rejected response; the validator remains authoritative
diagnostics.client_unavailable_after_error: Existing managed-client flag, observed without resetting it
diagnostics.network_limit: Existing response transport errors remain coarse; do not infer socket error or port exhaustion from a generic unavailable message.

output: Explicit prepare_failure_prefix then failure_prefix in a fresh isolated output. Exclusive manifests/run-start/results remain separate from original accuracy/realtime outputs. Retain all363 statuses; remaining rows become not_run after failure.
cleanup: Unchanged exact owned service stop and launcher/interpreter/Job receipts on every path; no18867 attach or global kill.
success_interpretation: A successful prefix neither completes the original1315 accuracy run nor proves the old unknown cause was repaired; a new full baseline would need its own declaration.
software_checks: Local fake HTTP responses for wrong instance, invalid revision, HTTP409 and invalid JSON; existing no-request stop test. No actual model or device.
